input.summary: Delete the one-way non-solicit/no-hire imposed on Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-way, 24-month no-hire covering all Vendor employees that expressly overrides general advertising, so we have deleted it; this also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, which confirms we give no no-hire commitment. If you need something here, we can accept a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no hiring restriction.
